meta.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Qo'shma so'zlar tuzog'i: Spiker ikkita alohida so'zni urg'u bilan aytib, sizni ikkita bo'sh joy bor deb o'ylatadi. Masalan: "We need a new bicycle rack" o'rniga "bicycle... rack" deb to'xtalishi mumkin, siz esa buni bicycle track deb yozib adashasiz. 💡 Oltin qoida: Matn ma'nosiga qarang. Agar u bitta buyumni bildirsa, so'zlarni qo'shib yozing: "The library offers a great study room for students." 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz
